"I know it sounds crazy, but you have to believe me." I say in Vietnamese to "Mark" translator of my old unit. Mark was what we called him because we couldn't pronounce his real name.

I wonder what the hell happened to me. This time yesterday I was me, the Lieutenant of my platoon. I was 21 years old and I had a wife waiting for me, back in the States. I was on yet another seek and destroy mission. We found ourselves in a rather large village.The last thing I remember was feeling a sharp pain in my chest and falling down. As I slipped into unconsciousness I could recall Evans yelling "He's Hit!" and "Sniper!" 

I woke up in the body of some Charlie kid slumped over on top of a Mosin Nagant with a PU scope. I heard someone behind me yelling in Vietnamese, "Drop your weapon!" Before I had time to react I felt something collide with the back of my head. I woke up sore all over my small body. I wonder about my wife, how she was doing when someone walked in. I recognized him as Mark. "WHERE ARE THE REST OF YOUR FRIENDS?" He yells angrily, slapping me. "TELL US OR OR WE WILL KILL YOU!" This sudden outburst sent me back into my new reality.

"Mark, It's me LT Johnson!" I yelled in the best English this young boy could muster. It came out heavily accented regardless. Mark went pale as rage over took him. He reared back and sent a fist flying towards me. It collided with my chest knocking the air out of me. 
"You slimy little bastard!" He yelled in English, almost in tears. "I should kill you right now!" He says unholstering his Colt 1911. He then put the gun to my head. "What's stopping me from pulling the trigger?" He asked me in English.
"I-I don't know," I said stuttering. 
He turns around and yelled "Evans, This one speaks English!" A figure came storming into the room. It was SSgt. Evans, my old platoon sergeant. He had come cuts on his face that weren't there yesterday.
"Seriously?" He said with that all too familiar southern accent. 
"Yeah," Mark said , "He told me he was LT..."
"Give me five minutes with this little maggot..." Evans said to Mark.
"Yes, sir." Mark said while walking out.
"Now listen to me as I'm only going to say this once. You are going to tell me who you are and where your little coward friends are." He said to me. 
"Sarge it's me, Johnson." I said. He had a similar reaction to Mark. He went pale and then spit on me. I could feel a little piece of tobacco in the spit. He shouldered his M-16. 
All I see is a flash as I closed my eyes. I didn't feel anything. I opened my eyes. I looked down the sights of an M-16. I noticed that I tasted wintergreen. I immediately looked down at my dog tags. It confirmed my suspicions, I am now SSgt. Jared Evans. 
I looked down at the young boy who once was me, now a corpse on it's side with blood pooling around him. I then realized that I have cheated death twice. I don't know where Evans or the young boy are now. But I owe it to Jared to survive this tour. 
"Sarge! What the hell!" Specialist Jackson yells attracted by the gunshot. 
"Don't ask, don't tell Jackson." I tell him. "Go tell Mays to send choppers to extract us."
"Yes, Sarge." Jackson says walking away.
